definition: Per decision with net exposure G (position value / equity): s(G) = max(g(G) / g(G*), F), and s(G) = F for a ruinous decision. g(G) = (1 - p) E_Z[ln(1 + G (e^(m + sigma Z) - 1))] + p ln(1 - G J) is the exact expected log growth of holding G for one decision (96-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature; minus infinity if G >= 1/J). G* = argmax g. F = g(G_ruin) / g(G*), the score of the smallest ruinous long position (G_ruin = 0.95 / J in S6; for a market without crashes, the size at which a 5-sigma fall reaches the 5% death line). Ruinous: G >= G_ruin long, or |G| >= 0.95 / (e^(m + 5 sigma) - 1) short. Q2 of an episode = mean of s over its decisions; Q2 of an evaluation = mean of the episode values. Uses only the decisions and the market's known parameters, never realised returns.
